newsitem.title: YEMEN: Eight die in Yemen schools machinegun attack.
newsitem.headline: Eight die in Yemen schools machinegun attack.

text.p: A school headmistress, a teacher and six children were killed on Sunday when a man fired a machinegun at hundreds of pupils at two schools in the Yemeni capital, a security official said.
An Interior Ministry statement said a total of 11 pupils from the two neighbouring schools and three other people were wounded.
The security official named the headmistress as Asma Noman, an Egyptian woman in her 40s whose son was also killed.
Police arrested the gunman. Witnesses said he was a disgruntled former bus driver at the Tala'eh school but the security official said he believed the assailant was insane.
Witnesses said the attacks spread panic among the more than 1,000 students in the adjacent schools in the middle class suburb of Asbahi.
Some of the panic-stricken children dived for cover while others ran away, the witnesses said.
The schools were closed after the shootings, which witnesses said were the first such incident in the capital of the impoverished Arab state.
The witnesses said they believed the gunman, who walked from the Tala'eh school to the second, Musa Ibn al-Naseer, was angry over his sacking by the headmistress.
